description: This file defines the TextFragment class and related iterator class within the Thunder::Core namespace. It provides functionality for handling text segments, including indexing, comparison, trimming, and iteration over text fragments.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a segment of text, supporting comparison, trimming, and data access.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing segments within a TextFragment, supporting iteration with delimiters.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between TextFragments or with C-style strings or std::string.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between TextFragments or with C-style strings or std::string.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the TextFragment is empty.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the text segment.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the text data.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the text content as a std::string.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Compares the text with another TextFragment or string, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character or substring starting from an offset.

methods.name: ForwardSkip
methods.description: Skips characters until a character not in the delimiter set is found.

methods.name: TrimBegin
methods.description: Trims characters from the beginning based on delimiters.

methods.name: TrimEnd
methods.description: Trims characters from the end based on delimiters.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character or substring.

methods.name: ReverseSkip
methods.description: Skips characters from the end based on delimiters.
